title: The web's remaining buttons follow 05's radius rule: 10 px on phones, a pill from 640 px
acceptance: The 18 copper primaries that are pills at every width either take `rounded-control sm:rounded-pill` or are named in 05 › Buttons as exceptions, with the reason. On main after RF-236 they are ClassesHome.tsx:583, CustomMovesDialog.tsx:277, Dashboard.tsx:4296, MarketingPage.tsx:87, :117 and :187, PlaylistSongPicker.tsx:154, SongPicks.tsx:281, SourceList.tsx:184, TrackSearch.tsx:1056, :1082, :1118 and :1185, and, on deferred surfaces, ExploreDialog.tsx:191, ShareDialog.tsx:180 and :222 and TeamsDialog.tsx:171 and :255.

The outlined, ghost and destructive buttons follow the same rule or are named as exceptions. Today some keep the control, input, card or pill radius at every width, and others already use `rounded-control sm:rounded-pill`. Each is checked by eye: some lines that match a button's classes are cards, chips or rows, which keep their own radius.
05 › Buttons and the web's buttons agree, and 08's rows still describe both platforms correctly.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-23) from RF-236 (#786). Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Unstarted. Find the primaries with `git grep -n rf-btn-primary -- 'apps/web/src/**/*.tsx' ':!*.test.tsx'` and keep the lines with `rounded-pill` but not `sm:rounded-pill`; SourceList's radius is on the line above its `rf-btn-primary`. Explore, Share and Teams are deferred surfaces (AGENTS.md › Product Boundaries), so leave them unchanged unless the owner reopens them. Whether the signed-out marketing page's calls to action stay pills on phones is the owner's call.

evidence.summary: RF-236's PR states 05's rule (10 px below 640 px, a pill from 640 px) and brings 11 copper primaries and Login's Apple button into line. It leaves the 18 primaries that are pills at every width and the other button variants to this task.
Buttons: radius `control` (10px) below the `sm` breakpoint (640px) and `pill` from it up, as RF-236 wrote it.
